treaty_name: Convention between the United Kingdom and Sweden for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital gains (2015, as amended 2021)
eif_quote: 2015 Double Taxation Convention The double taxation convention entered into force on 20 December 2015: It’s effective in the UK from: 1 January 2016 for taxes withheld at source 1 April 2016 for Corporation Tax 6 April 2016 for Income Tax and Capital Gains Tax It is effective in Sweden from 1 January 2016 for: taxes withheld at source other taxes on income
source_title: 2015 UK-Sweden Double Taxation Convention, as amended in 2021 — in force (gov.uk consolidated HTML); 2021 Protocol

rates.quote: However, if the beneficial owner is a company which controls, directly or indirectly, at least 10 per cent of the voting power in the company paying the dividends, the dividends shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident.

However, dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State may also be taxed in that State and according to its laws, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
Interest arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.basis: treaty art. 27A (inserted by 2021 Protocol Art. VII)
ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital gains if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Rates unchanged since the 2015 convention (effective for WHT 1 Jan 2016 in both States); the 2021 Protocol (in force 30 Dec 2021, effective for WHT 1 Jan 2022) deleted the main-purpose paragraphs Arts. 10(6), 11(5), 12(5) and inserted the PPT as Art. 27A. Dividends: 15% cap for dividends paid out of immovable-property income by a tax-exempt investment vehicle distributing most of its income annually (Art. 10(2) third sentence) — not modelled. 10% voting-power test, no holding period. Art. 27 (preferential regimes) denies treaty reductions to companies deriving income primarily from other states from shipping/financial or HQ/coordination-centre activities taxed under a preferential regime. MLI: treaties_merged records Sweden reserved Art. 35(7)(a) with no 35(7)(b) notification found, so the MLI is not treated as having effect; PPT applies anyway under the treaty's own Art. 27A.
